scope: Gumroad English listing launcher generated JavaScript

defect.root_cause: The Python generator embedded a literal newline inside a single-quoted JavaScript string used by tags.join().
defect.observed_result: node --check reported SyntaxError: Invalid or unexpected token.
defect.user_impact: The launcher initialization stopped before title, description, and tags were prefilled, and before the copy handler was installed.

fix.change: Emit an escaped newline sequence in generated JavaScript instead of a literal newline inside the string literal.

runtime_assertions: tags field contains all tags separated by newlines
clipboard payload exactly matches the visible listing data and product ZIP path
